column1: # English business-name words (curated 2026-11-10). Trade words were read by hand from the words
# most over-represented in each division's names in the Companies House register (read_registers.py,
# lift >= 3, in 40+ names), brands and place names left out. kind: style (how names are put
# together), template (a pattern's forms, with weights), trade (per ISIC division, ";"-separated),
# adjective, region, family, joiner, coined_head, coined_tail (syllables coined names are made of).
# Non-Latin words carry their Latin form after "=", and so do templates with non-Latin text
# ({surname}商店={surname}shoten). A trade key may be a section letter: it serves every division of
# the section that has no row of its own. "word:weight" weights a word (default 1).
